# Associations, Comittees, and Fellowships

- Interdisciplinary Marine Early Career Network (IMECaN), *Steering Committee.* More information available at: https://imber.info/imecan-interdisciplinary-marine-early-career-network/

- Voceros del Cambio climático (EDF-Mexico). *Member.*

- Leaders for Sea Change Fellowship (COMPASS). *Fellow.* More information available at: https://www.compassscicomm.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/Leaders-for-Sea-Change-Cohort-2020.pdf

- Graduate Pursuits Fellowship (SESYNC). *Fellow* More information available at: https://www.sesync.org/project/graduate-pursuits-request-for-proposals/ch-ch-ch-changes-using-marine-protected-areas-to

- Latin American Fisheries Fellowship (LAFF). *Fellow*. More information available at: https://www.laff.bren.ucsb.edu/laff-network
